resolved_commands: bash -c 'for r in docs/superpowers/pre-eval/*.json; do /usr/bin/python3 -B -c "import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$r" || exit 1; done; /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-preeval.py --selftest'
full_command: bash -c 'for s in scripts/compound-v-preeval.py scripts/compound-v-localize.py scripts/compound-v-taxonomy.py scripts/compound-v-validate-taxonomy.py scripts/compound-v-fastpath-run.py scripts/compound-v-classify-request.py scripts/compound-v-validate-manifest.py; do /usr/bin/python3 -B "$s" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $s"; exit 1; }; done; for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/v2.9-e2e -p "test_*.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL e2e"; exit 1; }; echo all-tests-ok'
